resolutions.title: The 'full-record schema block' test counts address-reviews' worked examples, so the reference holds three blocks, not one
resolutions.action: Settled under R-crc-3: option A. The requirement states that a worked example omits `command` and is not a schema block (a worked example carrying it fails loudly as a schema block with no example); task 3.3 removes `command` from address-reviews' worked-example blocks (a) and (b), making the 'six blocks' count true on the applied tree; design D1 records the measurement. Option B was REFUTED by measurement before adoption: review's architecture-mode block sits under '## Architecture-mode extensions' and the review-external block under '### JSON shape', so 'first JSON block under ## Schema' would miss two real schema blocks. An explicit info-string tag for schema blocks was declined as new mechanism (R-crc-6).

final_assessment: One of one resolved. The in-context pass's own leaning (B, a positional definition) was refuted by a heading map before adoption — two of the six real schema blocks sit under other headings — so the walk took A: worked examples omit `command` by convention, task 3.3 removes it from address-reviews' two worked examples, and the six-block count holds on the applied tree. No new mechanism; validates --strict.
